$comment: Inert MK2 → MK3 conversion notes, generated by scripts/convert-mk2.mjs. Not a contribution, not a schema and not on the loader manifest glob: this is the debt of a mechanical conversion, written down as data. `lostPlanes` are v1 entrypoints a codec contribution has no home for (a viewer is its own contribution kind, 13C; a language plane has no X3 form) — the converter drops the plane instead of inventing a spec for it. `contractGaps` are v1 verbs whose extra plane has no bundled X3 contract; the readable inspection side may still be a stub, but this debt is not presented as implemented. `renames` are the AC §5 operation-id fixes the conversion applied. `converterDefaults` are choices v1 did not make; REPORT §7.6/§7.7 asks each port to narrow them. `droppedOperations` are v1 operation ids emitted without a handler, spelled as v2 would. `needsSignatures` means no candidate rule survived conversion and `match.signatures` has to be declared by hand before the codec can be a candidate. Re-run `pnpm convert:mk2` instead of editing.

converterDefaults: signatures:from-specification (Adobe Video File Format Specification v10.1 §E.2 (FLV header: "FLV" + version))
signatures:from-specification (SWF File Format Specification v19 §"The SWF header" (FWS / CWS / ZWS))
